name: Christmas—Gathering Evergreens and The Christmas-Tree
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Christmas—Gathering Evergreens and The Christmas-Tree” by Winslow Homer (published December 25, 1858), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 158356. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
